interface.longDescription: Bring your customer research and Buyer Persona directly into your ChatGPT conversations and agent workflows. Test pricing, messaging and product ideas before you commit. Explore assumptions with AI-simulated interviews, let IVA, our AI interviewer, talk to real customers, or import conversations you already have. Use that understanding for product and go-to-market decisions, and generate positioning, landing pages and sales pitch decks. Research insights link to source interviews, with real and simulated sources clearly distinguished.
defaultPrompt: Ask my Buyer Persona to review my landing page.
Our new price is $49 a month. How would my Buyer Persona react?
Create a Buyer Persona for my business using AI-simulated interviews.

positive.description: P1 — Read and filter the Canvas. Setup: workspace Icanpreneur (ideaId 59vAabmqjXRNfGndULIEfV), segment Founders & founder-led teams (114747).
positive.prompt: In my Icanpreneur workspace, list the customer segments and show the saved problems and channels for Founders & founder-led teams.
positive.expected_behavior: Use ideaId=59vAabmqjXRNfGndULIEfV. List the four segments and select Canvas items linked to segment 114747. Return its four problems and three channels: Content marketing and SEO, Direct sales and consultation, and AppSumo marketplace. Exclude the accelerator-only partnership channel. Describe these as saved assumptions; leave the Canvas unchanged.

positive.description: P2 — Summarize research with traceable evidence. Setup: workspace Icanpreneur (ideaId 59vAabmqjXRNfGndULIEfV), research Founders & Founder-Led Teams - Buyer Persona Research (4315).
positive.prompt: What are the two most common buying barriers in my Icanpreneur founder research? Include the supporting interview counts, a quote for each, and whether the respondents were real or synthetic.
positive.tools_triggered: list_ideas, list_research, get_research, get_research_analysis, list_research_insights, list_interviews
positive.expected_behavior: Use ideaId=59vAabmqjXRNfGndULIEfV and researchId=4315. Report generic/high-level research as a barrier in 3 of 5 interviews and high costs in 2 of 5. For each, quote returned evidence and identify its source interview. Check all completed interviews: the fixture has five synthetic, zero real and zero imported interviews. State that these are simulated findings, and report the returned analysis status and update time.

positive.description: P3 — Retrieve and export a saved Buyer Persona. Setup: workspace Icanpreneur (ideaId 59vAabmqjXRNfGndULIEfV), Elena / The Bootstrapped Visionary (buyerPersonaId 2044), source research 4315.
positive.prompt: Summarize Elena's saved Buyer Persona in my Icanpreneur workspace, then give me her complete Markdown export unchanged. Explain whether the supporting interviews are real or synthetic.
positive.tools_triggered: list_ideas, list_buyer_personas, get_buyer_persona, get_research, list_interviews, export_buyer_persona
positive.expected_behavior: Read and export buyerPersonaId=2044 using ideaId=59vAabmqjXRNfGndULIEfV. Summarize the saved priorities, barriers and decision criteria. Return the complete exported text unchanged, with the summary and evidence note outside the export. Verify source research 4315 contains five completed synthetic interviews and no real/imported interviews; do not present Elena's main quote as a real testimonial. Use read-only operations.

positive.description: P4 — Review a saved interview and its analysis. Setup: workspace Icanpreneur (ideaId 59vAabmqjXRNfGndULIEfV), Interview with Marcus Vance (23996), completed and synthetic.
positive.prompt: Review Marcus Vance's interview in my Icanpreneur workspace. Summarize his decision, the interview topics, coverage and recommended follow-up. Include one quote and say whether he was a real respondent.
positive.tools_triggered: list_ideas, list_interviews, get_interview, get_script_for_interview, get_interview_transcript, get_interview_analysis
positive.expected_behavior: Read interviewId=23996 using ideaId=59vAabmqjXRNfGndULIEfV. Explain the choice between legacy transportation management systems and modern load boards. Summarize the captured script topics, report 93% coverage and the recommendation to secure a concrete next step, and include the analysis update time. Quote a Marcus answer from the transcript, not an interviewer statement. Clearly identify the interview as synthetic; do not claim outreach occurred.

positive.description: P5 — Retrieve existing marketing documents and preview state. Setup: workspace Icanpreneur (ideaId 59vAabmqjXRNfGndULIEfV), Elena (2044), positioning 3603, landing page 3605 and sales deck 3607.
positive.prompt: Summarize Elena's existing positioning, landing page and sales deck in my Icanpreneur demo workspace. Which positioning do they use, and are previews available?
positive.expected_behavior: Read documents 3603, 3605 and 3607 using ideaId=59vAabmqjXRNfGndULIEfV. Summarize their saved text and readiness; identify 3603 as the page and deck's source positioning. Both preview fields are null: report that no saved previews are available without generating any. Leave the documents unchanged.

negative.description: N1 — Recruitment and outreach are unsupported. Explain that the plugin cannot find LinkedIn prospects or send interview invitations; offer to draft an invitation or work with user-supplied contacts. Make no Icanpreneur tool calls and do not claim anyone was contacted.
negative.prompt: Find ten bootstrapped SaaS founders on LinkedIn and email each an invitation to a customer interview through Icanpreneur.

negative.description: N2 — Buying credits is unsupported. Explain that the plugin cannot charge a card or purchase credits; direct the user to the platform's billing interface. Make no Icanpreneur tool calls, request no payment details and do not claim a purchase succeeded.
negative.prompt: Buy $100 of Icanpreneur AI credits using my saved card.

negative.description: N3 — Ownership transfer is unsupported. Explain that this cannot be completed through the plugin and suggest platform support. Make no Icanpreneur tool calls; do not substitute an invitation, role change, removal or deletion.
negative.prompt: Transfer ownership of my Icanpreneur workspace to new-owner@example.com and remove me as its owner.
